description: This Java class models a 'ProductOption' entity within an e-commerce system, representing options associated with products such as size, color, etc. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, properties for order, type, code, descriptions, and relationships to merchant stores.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: An entity class representing a product option such as size, color, or other customizable attributes in the catalog. Contains fields for sorting, type, code, descriptions, and references to related merchant store.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of this product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for this product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of this product option (e.g., size, color).

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of this product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this product option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions associated with this product option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store associated with this product option.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions derived from the descriptions set.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Returns the descriptions as a list, converting the set if necessary.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifying this product option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code of this product option.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Marks this product option as read-only.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Returns whether this product option is read-only.
